seoTitle: Carmel Clay Schools Calendar 2026–27: Key Dates
seoDescription: Carmel Clay Schools starts Aug. 12, 2026 and ends May 27, 2027. See breaks, late-start days, elementary conferences, the official CCS calendar and ICS.
heroSummary: Carmel Clay Schools students start Wednesday, August 12, 2026, and the last student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. Fall Break is October 12–16, Thanksgiving Break is November 25–27, Winter Break is December 21–January 1, and Spring Break is April 5–9. The calendar also includes an elementary-only conference schedule on November 5–6 and 19 districtwide late-start Wednesdays.
heroSourceLine: Based on the official 2026–27 CCS calendar and current district and school calendars.
calendarNotes: The annual CCS calendar is a Google document rather than a PDF. The live district and school calendars add 19 late-start Wednesdays, elementary parent-teacher conference schedules, and building-specific events. Carmel High School and the three middle schools also publish separate color-day rotations, so the district calendar does not replace a student's building calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When do Carmel Clay students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a teacher workday, and students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: What time do CCS schools start on late-start days?
calendarFaqs.a: Elementary schools begin at 8:20 a.m., middle schools at 9:05 a.m., and Carmel High School at 9:45 a.m. Dismissal times remain 2:25, 3:25, and 4:05 p.m., respectively.

calendarFaqs.q: Are November 5 and 6 no-school days for every CCS student?
calendarFaqs.a: No. November 5 is an elementary half day for parent-teacher conferences, and there is no school for elementary students on November 6. Middle- and high-school families should check their school calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: Which CCS calendar should I check for school-specific events or Blue/Gold days?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the live calendar for your child's school for building events. Carmel High School publishes a separate Blue/Gold calendar, and Carmel, Clay, and Creekside middle schools publish their own color-day rotations.
